_comment: Raptor's egg library (library/README.md). Written for Raptor.
name: Prosody
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: Prosody is a lightweight XMPP (Jabber) chat server. The egg serves one domain to clients on the server's port, with accounts made by the admin rather than open sign-ups.
startup: p=/home/container/pkgs; t=$(uname -m)-linux-gnu; export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=$p/usr/lib/$t LUA_PATH_5_4="$p/usr/share/lua/5.4/?.lua;$p/usr/share/lua/5.4/?/init.lua;;" LUA_CPATH_5_4="$p/usr/lib/$t/lua/5.4/?.so;;"; if [ -n "${ADMIN_PASSWORD:-}" ] && [ ! -f "data/$(printf %s "${XMPP_DOMAIN}" | sed 's/\./%2e/g; s/-/%2d/g')/accounts/${ADMIN_USER}.dat" ]; then $p/usr/bin/lua5.4 $p/usr/bin/prosodyctl register "${ADMIN_USER}" "${XMPP_DOMAIN}" "${ADMIN_PASSWORD}" && echo "Created the account ${ADMIN_USER}@${XMPP_DOMAIN}." || exit 1; fi; exec $p/usr/bin/lua5.4 $p/usr/bin/prosody -F

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Prosody: installs Prosody and Lua from Debian 13's packages (with
# security updates, checked against Debian's signing keys) into pkgs/, and
# writes a first configuration. Accounts and messages (data/), settings and
# certificates (config/) and your plugins are never touched; reinstall to
# update.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
work=/mnt/server/.raptor-build
rm -rf "$work" && mkdir -p "$work"
trap 'rm -rf "$work"' EXIT
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }
# Debian 13's packages (with its security updates), fetched and checked by
# apt against Debian's signing keys, and unpacked into $1 (replaced only
# once the new one is complete). The runtime image is Debian 13 too.
debian_packages() {
    local dest=$1; shift
    local a="$work/apt"
    mkdir -p "$a/lists/partial" "$a/cache/archives/partial" "$a/dl" "$a/prefs"
    cat > "$a/sources.list" <<SRC
deb http://deb.debian.org/debian trixie main
deb http://deb.debian.org/debian trixie-updates main
deb http://security.debian.org/debian-security trixie-security main
SRC
    local opts=(-q -o Dir::Etc::SourceList="$a/sources.list" -o Dir::Etc::SourceParts=/nonexistent
        -o Dir::Etc::Preferences=/nonexistent -o Dir::Etc::PreferencesParts="$a/prefs"
        -o Dir::State::Lists="$a/lists" -o Dir::Cache="$a/cache" -o Dir::State::status=/dev/null
        -o Debug::NoLocking=1 -o APT::Sandbox::User=root)
    apt-get "${opts[@]}" update > "$a/update.log" 2>&1 || { tail -n 5 "$a/update.log"; fail "Debian's package servers can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."; }
    (cd "$a/dl" && apt-get "${opts[@]}" download "$@" > "$a/download.log" 2>&1) || { tail -n 5 "$a/download.log"; fail "Debian's packages couldn't be downloaded. Reinstall to try again."; }
    rm -rf "$dest.new" && mkdir -p "$dest.new"
    local f
    for f in "$a"/dl/*.deb; do dpkg-deb -x "$f" "$dest.new"; done
    (cd "$a/dl" && ls *.deb) > "$dest.new/.raptor-packages"
    rm -rf "$dest" && mv "$dest.new" "$dest"
}

case "$(uname -m)" in
    x86_64) triplet=x86_64-linux-gnu ;;
    aarch64) triplet=aarch64-linux-gnu ;;
    *) fail "Prosody isn't packaged for this CPU ($(uname -m))." ;;
esac
domain="${XMPP_DOMAIN:-localhost}"

echo "Downloading Prosody from Debian 13"
debian_packages pkgs prosody lua5.4 liblua5.4-0 libreadline8t64 lua-socket lua-expat lua-filesystem lua-sec lua-bitop lua-unbound libunbound8 libevent-2.1-7t64
version=$(sed -n 's/^prosody_\([^_]*\)_.*/\1/p' pkgs/.raptor-packages)
[ -f pkgs/usr/bin/prosody ] && [ -x pkgs/usr/bin/lua5.4 ] || fail "Debian's Prosody package didn't have Prosody where it should. Report this to Raptor."
# Prosody's own folders: the server's, instead of the system's.
for f in prosody prosodyctl; do
    sed -i -e "s|^CFG_SOURCEDIR=.*|CFG_SOURCEDIR='/home/container/pkgs/usr/lib/prosody';|" \
        -e "s|^CFG_CONFIGDIR=.*|CFG_CONFIGDIR='/home/container/config';|" \
        -e "s|^CFG_PLUGINDIR=.*|CFG_PLUGINDIR='/home/container/pkgs/usr/lib/prosody/modules/';|" \
        -e "s|^CFG_DATADIR=.*|CFG_DATADIR='/home/container/data';|" "pkgs/usr/bin/$f"
    grep -q "^CFG_CONFIGDIR='/home/container/config';" "pkgs/usr/bin/$f" || fail "Debian's $f has changed shape. Report this to Raptor."
done
mkdir -p config/certs data plugins

# A first prosody.cfg.lua: the domain, port and admin come from the egg's
# variables at every start (Prosody reads ENV_ names from the environment).
if [ ! -f config/prosody.cfg.lua ]; then
    cat > config/prosody.cfg.lua <<'LUA'
-- Prosody's settings: https://prosody.im/doc/configure
-- ENV_<NAME> is the server's variable <NAME>, read at every start.

admins = { ENV_ADMIN_USER .. "@" .. ENV_XMPP_DOMAIN }
plugin_paths = { "/home/container/plugins" }

modules_enabled = {
	"disco"; "roster"; "saslauth"; "tls"; "blocklist"; "bookmarks"; "carbons";
	"dialback"; "limits"; "pep"; "private"; "smacks"; "vcard4"; "vcard_legacy";
	"account_activity"; "cloud_notify"; "csi_simple"; "ping"; "register"; "time";
	"uptime"; "version"; "admin_adhoc"; "mam";
}

-- Accounts are made by the admin (prosodyctl, or ad-hoc commands in an
-- XMPP client), not by anyone who connects.
allow_registration = false

-- Clients on the server's port. Federation with other servers needs a
-- second port in s2s_ports (and DNS records); web services in http_ports.
c2s_ports = { Lua.tonumber(ENV_SERVER_PORT) }
s2s_ports = { }
http_ports = { }
https_ports = { }
c2s_direct_tls_ports = { }
s2s_direct_tls_ports = { }

c2s_require_encryption = true
s2s_secure_auth = true
authentication = "internal_hashed"
storage = "internal"
archive_expires_after = "1w"

limits = {
	c2s = { rate = "10kb/s" };
	s2sin = { rate = "30kb/s" };
}

pidfile = "/home/container/data/prosody.pid"
log = { { levels = { min = "info" }, to = "console" } }

-- A self-signed certificate made at install; put a real one (such as
-- Let's Encrypt's) in config/certs as <domain>.crt and <domain>.key.
certificates = "certs"

VirtualHost(ENV_XMPP_DOMAIN)

Include "conf.d/*.cfg.lua"
LUA
    mkdir -p config/conf.d
    echo "Wrote a first prosody.cfg.lua."
fi
mkdir -p config/conf.d
if [ ! -f "config/certs/$domain.crt" ] && [ ! -f "config/certs/$domain.key" ]; then
    (umask 077; openssl req -x509 -newkey rsa:3072 -nodes -days 3650 -subj "/CN=$domain" \
        -addext "subjectAltName=DNS:$domain,DNS:*.$domain" \
        -keyout "config/certs/$domain.key" -out "config/certs/$domain.crt" 2>/dev/null) ||
        fail "The certificate for $domain couldn't be made."
    echo "Made a self-signed certificate for $domain."
fi
echo "Installed Prosody $version."

variables.name: Domain
variables.description: The XMPP domain accounts belong to (the part after @), such as chat.example.com. The install makes a self-signed certificate for it.

variables.name: Admin username
variables.description: The admin account's name (before the @), which can manage the server from an XMPP client.

variables.name: Admin password
variables.description: The admin account's password, used when the account is created. Leave it empty to make no account.
